name: Adam Curley
title: Psychologist
description: Prioritises creating a trauma-aware, affirming, and culturally responsive space. Particular interest in the ongoing impacts of early life stress and trauma, including difficult family dynamics, abuse, marginalisation. Works flexibly with Schema Therapy, Emotion-Focused Individual Therapy, psychodynamic technique, ACT, CBT, and DBT. Available: Carlton Clinic: Thursdays and Fridays.
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, EFT, psychodynamic, identity, self-esteem

name: Bill Darby
title: Psychologist
description: Works with people of all backgrounds, and is sensitive to the experiences of LGBTIQAP+ people, people from diverse and minority backgrounds, and those experiencing challenges around anxiety, trauma, gender, sexuality, and relationships (including non-traditional relationships). Brings previous experience in peer-based and community approaches, and values personal lived experience. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Fridays; Carlton Clinic: Wednesdays.
specialties: LGBTIQAP+, trauma, gender, sexuality, non-traditional relationships

name: Cait Barr
title: Psychologist
description: Holistic and relational; draws from Psychodynamic Psychotherapy, Emotion-Focused Therapy, and ACT, enjoying longer term work. Helps with trauma, identity and self-esteem, LGBTQIA+ issues, disordered eating, grief and anxiety. Cait has a special interest in working with queer women. Available: Carlton Clinic: Tuesdays & Wednesdays.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, queer women, trauma, psychodynamic, EFT, ACT, disordered eating

name: David Edmonds
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Draws from CBT, ACT, DBT, EMDR and Motivational Interviewing. Experience with trauma, personality disorders, neurodiversity, body image and more across children, adolescents and adults. Special interest in working with individuals who also belong to the LGBTIQAP+ community and/or neurodivergent individuals. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Wednesday; Carlton Clinic: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, LGBTIQAP+, neurodivergence, DBT, ACT, CBT

name: Dee Tuncel
title: Psychologist
description: Passionate about the journey toward self-acceptance, especially around identity. 'Dee is LGBTQIAP+ inclusive, sex-positive, and kink-positive', welcoming clients aged 15+. Trained in ACT, CBT, DBT and Internal Family Systems; offers a particularly affirming space for those exploring Autism and/or ADHD. Available: Carlton Clinic: Wednesdays & Saturdays.
specialties: LGBTQIAP+, sex-positive, kink-positive, IFS, neurodivergence, identity

name: Emily Alexander
title: Psychologist
description: Available for assessments only (autism, ADHD, dyslexia, cognitive, academic; ages 10+). Neurodiversity-affirming. Especially passionate about helping neurodivergent LGBTQIAP+ folk work towards self-acceptance and authenticity; skilled in internalised and high-masking presentations. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Monday, Thursday; Carlton Clinic: Tuesday.
specialties: autism assessment, ADHD assessment, LGBTQIAP+, neurodiversity-affirming, PDA

name: Emmett Radovich
title: Provisional Psychologist
description: Provisional psychologist in final year of training (no GP referral needed). Warm, affirming approach drawing on ACT, CBT and interpersonal therapy. Interest in ADHD, autism, anxiety, depression and chronic illness, and how these intersect within individual and collective queer, trans and neurodivergent experiences and identities. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.
specialties: trans, queer, neurodivergence, chronic illness, ACT, CBT, provisional psychologist
identity: 'Emmett is a queer trans man with lived experience of neurodivergence and chronic illness.'

name: Enzo Somosi
title: Psychologist
description: Works with OCD, anxiety, depression, trauma, personality difficulties, substance use, men's mental health and relationship difficulties. Uses CBT, ACT, CFT, DBT and ERP skills; trained in the Gottman Method and Couples Schema Therapy. Provides neuroaffirming and LGBTQIA+ inclusive care. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Wednesdas; Carlton Clinic: Mondays. Tuesdays, Thursdays.
specialties: trauma, OCD, couples schema therapy, Gottman, LGBTQIA+ inclusive, men's mental health

name: Halo Jones
title: Psychologist
description: 'Halo's work is informed by a lifetime of lived experience as a queer and transgender woman.' Advocate for TGD people in the family violence space; believes strongly in the human and social rights of gender and sexual minority groups. Particular interest in working with TGD and neurodiverse people. Works within a CBT framework. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Tuesday and Friday; Carlton Clinic: Thursday.
specialties: transgender, TGD, LGBTIQAP+, neurodiversity, CBT

name: Holly Pretorius
title: Senior Psychologist
description: Educational and developmental psychologist supporting children, adolescents and adults incl. identity exploration; particularly enjoys working with neurodivergent and LGBTQIAP+ adolescents. Uses CBT, Schema Therapy and Humanistic Therapy plus creative mediums. Special interests include PMDD, survivors of high-control groups (cults), and non-traditional relationship styles (polyamory, ethical non-monogamy). Works with therapy dog Cashew. Available: Carlton Clinic: Mondays, Tuesdays, Fridays.
specialties: LGBTQIAP+, schema therapy, polyamory, ethical non-monogamy, cult survivors, PMDD, neurodivergence, adolescents
identity: 'Holly herself is proudly queer and autistic'

name: Jessie Goldie
title: Provisional psychologist
description: Provisional psychologist in final year of training. Draws on ACT, CBT, DBT and Schema Therapy; experience with trauma, disordered eating, emotion regulation and relationship difficulties. Passionate about providing therapeutic support from an intersectional perspective to neurodivergent individuals and members of the LGBTQIAP+ community. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Thursdays; Geelong Clinic: Fridays.
specialties: schema therapy, trauma, LGBTQIAP+, neurodivergence, provisional psychologist

name: Jhocelyn Jobe
title: Psychologist
description: Enjoys working with her fellow LGBTQIAP+ community members from a standpoint that is neurodiverse affirming and trauma informed. Applies EFT to relationship counselling, inclusive of diverse relationship structures and kink dynamics. Supports LGBTQIAP+ exploration, trauma, attachment; adolescents (16+) and adults. Available to conduct Adult WPATH assessments for gender affirmation. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Mon, Tue, Fri.
specialties: LGBTQIAP+, kink, WPATH assessments, trauma, EFT, relationship counselling, late-diagnosed neurodivergence

name: Kate Langtry
title: Psychologist
description: Supports children, adolescents and adults with anxiety, depression, emotional regulation, self-esteem and identity, self-harm. Draws on CBT, ACT, DBT and trauma-informed approaches; offers ADHD, autism, educational and cognitive assessments. Mental Health Lived Experience Advisor at the Royal Children's Hospital. Available: Carlton Clinic: Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays; Geelong Clinic: Thursday.
specialties: trauma-informed, ADHD/autism assessment, self-harm, identity, DBT

name: Lilly McCann
title: Psychologist
description: Creates a safe, collaborative, and trauma-informed space for children, adolescents and adults. Uses DBT, CBT, ACT and Internal Family Systems (IFS). 'As a queer ADHDer, Lilly brings lived experience to her practice and is committed to providing inclusive and affirming support to LGBTQIAP+ clients.' Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Wednesdays; Carlton Clinic: Saturdays.
specialties: LGBTQIAP+, IFS, trauma-informed, DBT, PDA, ADHD

name: Logan Flott
title: Psychologist
description: Passionate about providing therapeutic support from an intersectional perspective to neurodivergent individuals and those within the LGBT+ community. Particular love for supporting complex trauma, eating disorders (ARFID, restrictive), self-harm and psychosis. Integrates DBT, Internal Family Systems (IFS), CBT, mindfulness and yoga (YRT-200) for trauma recovery; Gottman Level 1 for couples. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Tuesdays; Carlton Clinic: Mondays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays.
specialties: complex trauma, IFS, LGBT+, eating disorders, ARFID, psychosis, DBT, couples

name: Owen O'Neil
title: Senior Psychologist
description: Counselling psychologist dedicated to working with members of queer communities. Provides individual therapy and relationship therapy, particularly with queer, poly, and CNM relationships; special interest in complex trauma and addiction. 'Owen is a trauma-informed, gender-affirming, sex, kink, and sex worker positive, and neurodiversity affirming practitioner.' Favourite modalities: EFT, IFS, EMDR, ACT, Narrative Therapy. PsyBA approved supervisor. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Thursdays; Carlton Clinic: Mondays, Fridays.
specialties: queer, polyamory, CNM, complex trauma, EMDR, IFS, kink-positive, sex worker positive, gender-affirming, addiction
identity: 'a proud queer poly person'; 'a monolingual, poly, queer person'; '...situationally binary cisgender ... white-skinned, and non-Aboriginal privileges'

name: Rene Pirrotta
title: Practice Lead | Senior Psychologist
description: Practice Lead and Senior Psychologist. Works with trauma, substance-related concerns, attachment, emotional regulation; experience working with clients exploring their gender, sexuality, and neurodivergent identity. Focus on Schema Therapy, EMDR and DBT. PsyBA board-approved supervisor. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Monday to Friday.
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, EMDR, DBT, gender, sexuality

name: Serena Hillin
title: Psychologist
description: 'As a non-binary and neurodivergent individual, they welcome clients who are experiencing difficulties with their identity, mental health, or life path.' Works with ages eight to eighty. Draws upon CBT, ACT, IPT, LGBTQIA+ Affirmative Therapy, Internal Family Systems Therapy (Parts Work), and Narrative Therapy. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Thursday, Friday; Carlton Clinic: Monday.
specialties: non-binary, LGBTQIA+ affirmative, IFS, parts work, identity, narrative therapy

name: Sophie Glynn
title: Psychologist
description: LGBTQIA+ affirming and neuroaffirming practitioner acknowledging the unique difficulties that may be faced by queer and/or neurodivergent people. Supports adolescents and adults with trauma, addiction, anxiety, mood and relationships, and those exploring sexuality, gender, or neurodivergent identities. Primarily uses CBT, Schema Therapy, ACT and EMDR. Available: St. Kilda Clinic: Monday to Thursday.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, schema therapy, EMDR, trauma, gender, sexuality

name: Stanley Chin
title: Psychologist
description: 'Stanley is a transfeminine psychologist' providing a warm and non-judgmental approach for adult clients. Experience supporting gender, sexuality, grief, anxiety and relationships, and providing WPATH-guided informed consent discussions to support access to gender-affirming healthcare. Uses ACT, CBT and DBT. Available: Carlton Clinic: Mon, Tue, Wed.
specialties: transgender, gender-affirming, WPATH informed consent, sexuality, ACT, CBT, DBT

name: Steph Sier
title: Senior Therapist | MHASW
description: Senior clinician and mental health accredited social worker. 'Steph is an LGBTQIAP+ affirmative therapist.' Works across depression, anxiety, PTSD/trauma, personality disorders; uses ACT, CBT, DBT, mindfulness and is a qualified EMDR therapist. Available: Carlton Clinic: Tue, Wed, Thu.
specialties: LGBTQIAP+ affirmative, PTSD, trauma, EMDR, DBT
